user.title: Connect to the PC
user.description: Enter the address of the PC running PC Control Agent. Get the token from the tray icon: **Copy API token**.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the PC. A DHCP reservation is recommended.
data_description.port: The agent's port (8765 unless changed in config.json).

wake.title: Wake-on-LAN
wake.description: Choose the network adapter of {hostname} that receives Wake-on-LAN packets. The wired adapter is listed first.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token
reauth_confirm.description: The agent on {name} rejected the stored token. Paste the current one from the tray icon: **Copy API token**.

data_description.wake_timeout: How long to wait for the agent after sending Wake-on-LAN before giving up.
